BlackBerry - you're partially to blame for this too. Whether it's my memory card or settings that I can't figure out how to change, whenever I download photos from Facebook or Twitter, etc they don't go into my photos folder. The app is fine, but their help center is absolute garbage. Pros: intuitive, direct and free storage within Google network, face label, albums, photo scanning, stylized cool pics, grouped memory collages Cons: not enough photo editing capabilities, wish it was easier to tag a person in a photo, need more photo editing from within app. between the pixel 3xl and the Google photos we should be able to do it all, but especially blemishes, smiles, red eyes, scenery, let's make it easy to show what this camera can do in fogg or in the rain.

Terrific quality! Always adding valuable features like copying text off a menu, for example, so you can forward it in a message or save it in a document. It also lets you take a picture of something -- a flower or bird, for example -- and it will identify it for you. You can also doctor the lighting in photos and fix other flaws. Couldn't live without it!

Step 1: Offer something for free and kill other potential competitors Step 2: Everyone is invested in your ecosystem so raise the prices now that they have no alternatives anymore. Step 3: ??? Step 4: PROFIT!!! If this ain't a classic tactic of bait-and-switch, I don't know what else. I should've stuck with OneDrive that I already had instead of moving to Google Photos, only to have to move them back, a totally pointless endeavor... No reason to fragment my photo library over a pointless app.

I would be lost wothout my google photos. I love that i can log onto any device and get access to my photos and videos. It would be nice if there was more editing features with it that are easy to use (for beginners) or perhaps a add-on download that has that feature. I love some of the photos it edits and suggest to me i just wish i knew how to make them like that. Either way still awesome!

Mostly good, but wish better organizing. Features missing, such as After archiving pics from main bucket, to be able to share pics in albums, that were archived in main view bucket. Very cluttered; can't remember which pics I've already put into albums.... very annoying 😒.

Since the last update photos taken with the Phone camera will show normally for about a second, then automatically boost the light sources in the picture. I could not find a way to turn this "feature" off. While some photos might look better with the "enhancement", the big issue is that the photos you see in the photos app will be very different than the same photos you share on another app. Please give users a way to disable this nonsense, or turn it into a tool in the image editor.

it's great at backing up photos. But when trying to delete large number of photos, you have to select in groups (as you cannot select all, even with scrolling). With large number of photos, this is a pain and takes way too much time. In one forum I found you have to search (in my case, search by year) and then select those photos to delete. Could improve on managing storage. They seem to want to push you into paying for more cloud storage.

💕 I enjoy the Google photos app very much!! A very convenient way to store photos and super fun too editing them! It stores your photos away and as soon as you click on Google Photos, your new photos immediately arrive and are saved to Google photos. Also they are not shared and are marked private until you actually share them. Then they can see them or people can access them by a link. People wonder if everyone can see their photos but only he who owns the app can. Very smart app! 💕

I pay 1.99 to this app & I also use one drive also 1.99. Very similar, which is better? Depends on your device. I still use Windows Phones for my kids. I find i can limit a little more. But Photo, has a app known as PhotoScan, which makes perfect pics of items your wanting to share. Documents etc. However, if you use office- one drive is linked to your account and makes it easier for pc. So, i do both. Sometimes you can find yearly specials, its worth it. I personally prefer to get year specials.

I really like the automatic backup and unlimited photo storage. It has been great switching from iPhone to Android a few times over the past few years. My only beef, is that often when I try to upload photos to an album it will not save or keep the album with all of the images in it. I've tried updating the app, changing around certain settings and nothing seems to work, so that aspect of the albums is a hit or miss and can be somewhat frustrating at times.

I never think of saving photos from my phone, until my phone is a total loss. This app pops up seemingly at the best time and asks you to do so. And doesn't just save every photo, that would take me right out of decision. Just like this other PHONEI had it would save everything and have no space after a short time. Then you would have to buy a new one. But I'm sure that was the whole idea.

Since the update, every time I try to move one photo from one folder to another, the app creates a duplicate of said picture and doesn't let me back it up. I can't delete a duplicate without deleting the other one, so now I am stuck with the same photo in both folders. I tried saving from different sources (web, social media), but the same problem presents itself every time. Sometimes, the app doesn't even show the saved picture. Took a star away because of the difficulty of getting the app to do what you want not what it wants to do with the photos. I don't want them in archives I want to delete them. The app keeps wanting to send them to archives. There is also another update to install. Again Works great for me. I would have given it 5 stars but when you update it on the 25th and have to re-update it on the 27th again it shows you evrything can be improved on.

Easy to use, and I love how it brings up your memories. My original review is from 2016 which tells you I've been using it for a long time. Over the years of course they've tried to improve the app which has been a hit or miss. Sometimes it will automatically upload folders from your device that you have not selected to be uploaded which makes it frustrating because it removes it from your app once it uploads to the storage. Overall I still heavily use this app and still recommend it

You can do some really cool things with your pics with this app. I actually really love the suggestions they throw out at you periodically. They suggest fun animations and collages. They create books that you can edit and buy. I never would have thought to do that, and of course, I have to edit some pics to get these books just the way I want them, but it's cool that they suggest it and throw out ideas. Also, I like the "remember when," where they show you pics from years ago. Great to reminisce

I hate this app with a burning passion!!! The album's you create manually don't show up in other apps, not all of my photos are saved, and even when I delete stuff it comes back! The app has so many damn annoying and unnecessary features and the worst part is I can't delete it!! If I could give it negative stars I would! I just want a simple gallery app, damn!!!

I really enjoyed everything about this. I have a Pixel XL 2 so I'm enjoying the wonderful photos as well. I wish there was a way to create a private folder to put photos that you dont want anyone to see in there, and hide it like some Samsung devices give you. Also, once I did a back up of all my photos it removed them from the device and now I can't use them with Shutterfly app. All the other features are just great!!!!

UX has gotten progressively worse over time. It has become difficult to see where some of the automagically generated images (e.g. then and now, collages, etc.) are located after they pop up. Take for example the pop up, "New Version Available" when there is no new version available. I appreciate the app, but whomever is leading the product is leading it off of a cliff.

I take care I photos I shoot and backup. The app suddenly stopped uploading full quality images, failed to inform me of this change, causing hundreds of shoots to be uploaded ("high quality") small and pixelated and then deleted them all ("Free Up Space"). They informed me after, I now I have to pay to recieve my original photos. That is so greedy and unethical. Often spend a long time creating shared albums to get an error at the end. "Try again later". Only works on my PC from what I gather.

It's a really amazing app making videos appear with the repetition like tiktok. Although I had some saved videos a while ago and all of a sudden they disappeared from my home page, but if I were to log into my account on a pc they would show. Don't know why that was so...but I would like for it to be checked. All in all it's wonderful. Thanks Google!

Highlight videos sound is out of sync. Leaving a review of this app seems to be the only way to get in touch with Google about bugs so here we go. I love the option to make a highlight video out of my pics and vids, and it is quite easy to do. However, when publishing the video to my library the sounds always become out of sync. When I go back in and edit the highlight video the sound is fine again, but then after publishing the sound becomes more and more out of sync throughout the video.

Best app ever. Keeps absolutely every image and video backed up. Unlimited storage, everything in chronological order. You can search by key words of what is in the picture , from colors, to items, etc. And it will come up for the most part. It's amazing. Then the image animations , or collages and so much more that it puts together for you. It's truly an amazing app. Whether you're an iphone or Android user , we can ALL benefit greatly from this app.

A few issues have come up. I cannot use the "free up space" option. The app just closes or freezes when I click on it. Also, I ALWAYS have things backing up. Once in a while I will open the app and it will say "backup complete" but then one second later it says it's backing up 600 items. I have the setting set to backup using data. I have unistalled and reinstalled the app twice.

When browsing for pics from another app (SMS text, fb, IG, gmail, etc.), Photos doesn't organize my pics as albums. It displays the pics as a time indexed camera roll. I have to scroll through, potentially, years of photos to locate one taken in the past. To remedy this I would have to use the space and folder structure on my phone, which defeats to purpose of having unlimited space on Photos. Suggest to display album structure when browsing from other apps.

WHY is there not an option to retain device albums. I organize my photos my MY system and there will never be an algorithm that can possibly understand the difference between some categories. this is APPALLINGLY arrogant product design when it would be so simple to implement. IT ALREADY RECOGNIZES DEVICE ALBUMS. The premise of "we know how to sort your own photos better than you do :)" is the part that makes my blood boil. Dear development: do better and stop being so self assured.

Best photo app out there. The categories are amazing, you can make albums for different people and pets. Great facial recognition! It catches the cats even, and people over the years. How it knows what I looked like as a baby I don't know! I'm very pleased with this app, and we use it as a family so everyone's photos go into one account and we can sort through there. Easy to sort. You can search by events as well like "under water" or "sunset" and it pulls up all your pictures of those. Amazing

Stupid stupid photo app. I hate this thing. There's no way to organize your photos and God forbid you take a portrait photo! It will store every. single. photo. in a separate folder. So when you try to post a picture you have to literally scroll for minutes at a time trying to find the photo because it's not stored in your normal "Camera" folder. And there's no way to transfer it to the "Camera" folder. It will take me upwards of 30 freakin minutes to post pics on IG because of the set up.

Cool for everything else but sharpening. When I looked up why I got the stupidest answer in the world. The head of Google photos had the audacity to say that, "there won't be a sharpening tool anytime soon". There is literally no reason for this, please someone explain why Google will not add sharpening to the photo editing. Other than that everything else is good. The photo sharing is perfect, the time organization is great and the assistant is like having a kid make a drawing for you that you put up on the fridge.

Easy to share with others. The "memories" feature brings back pictures based on the date from the past - which are beautiful reminders of where you've been. "Archive" is a great feature as well, except it doesn't provide the option to delete instead of archive. Typically a bunch of archival photos are ones I'd like to delete. It's annoying that I do have to individually delete them, when the app already did the work of recognizing they were photos I probably didn't need.

I hate how it splits up my photos and arranges them how IT thinks my albums should be. It's hard to organize correctly and it's frustratingly difficult to find one specific picture when I've got to look through 50 random albums I didn't even make to get to it. I like the date stamps it puts on everything. I also like being able to share things with a wide range of apps, but this app itself is a nightmare.

Overall, excellent. Organises all photos by date and location, and creates videos, albums, and stylised photos for you. Also cleverly gives you the option of fixing lighting on some photos. I do wish, though, that ALL automatic creations were available to view on the app assistant page, not just the most recent ones. Also, be warned: despite what it says, you seemingly CANNOT undo changes after they have been made, and once you've chosen to not make suggested changes, the option won't reappear.

The app has made improvements over time and become really useful and way more technical, which I like. Folders, geolocarions, facial recognition is amazing, etc. The only thing I would ask is that multiple photos can be selected from across folders. For example, if I want to post pics to Facebook from my Camera, VZN Media, and Snapchat folders, I can select them, back out of the folder, open another folder, and keep selecting from there. That would literally be the best thing. Lol

Weirdly slow and annoying music in the memories. When looking through my gallery, it takes a while to load the thumbnails, even though the photos are all on my phone. Using the native gallery App shows all instantly. This makes browsing the photos a huge chore. Additionally, please allow muting the music during memories and other reels. I just want to be able to see and hear my videos and photos. It makes it very distracting, and sometimes the music is not appropriate for the context.

Thanks to googles photos app I have pictures that are over 5 years old! For most people, that is no big deal, but I have left behind everything I owned more than a few times. Photos can be heavy and fragile, so they get left behind. Now, no matter how many photos I have, no matter where I go, I can take them with me. For me, that is a gift that I could never have dreamed of. Thank you Google, for saving my photos and honestly for so much more.

Best photo app, easy to create albums and share it with the family. The storage plan is great and can be shared with other family member. Some gadget features like album automation or albums from few years ago are a very nice touch. The map is also a very nice way to explore the photos. Love the sync feature above all, kudos and great job for the team working on it.

Updated version (2025) NO, NO, NO, we didn't ask for a new editing interface and do not want it!! WHERE is the option to crop photos by one corner at a time, to change perspective?!? Whose terrible idea was this?!? 🤬

It's pretty good. Google banks on money spent for photo storage, so there is no incentive for them to do so, but a duplicate finder for past photos would be immensely helpful. Without it, I'm stuck combing through thousands of photos to delete the duplicates and triplicates I can find. Also, not sure what has glitched in their system recently, but many of the facial tags got mixed up in my account. Irritating and time consuming to fix. Otherwise, pretty good.

Great for backing up and sharing. I appreciate the updates to the app over the years. The backup feature has been reliable and I love the ability to back up photos across multiple devices to one account. I really like the sharing features and have been able to share photos to loved ones during this past year of COVID-19 lockdown. One feature I wish we could have is the ability to export the entire album (sort order, comments and inline album text) and not just the photos.

Had always worked as required but now will not open. It tries to start up but crashes every time. Also, how difficult would it be to make the link the developer replied with clickable? Or selectable so I could copy and paste it to the browser on my phone? Having to flip between apps whilst trying to remember a seemingly random series of letters and numbers doesn't help with the frustration. If there is already a way for me to do this easily, it's not obvious to an old geezer like me.

Has worked excellent in the past, however, recently, it has not been backing up any photos and says that all photos have already been backed up, which just isn't the case. Long overdue edit; The issue was my phone, so some reason it was just neglecting to work at all for literally anything. Since getting a different phone will say that the app is still amazing. Love that I can add in people and pets names, then type in their name in the search bar and only their pictures shows up.

Google photos is a great photo app considering its free. I've used a few other photo apps that i had to pay for and i still choose to use Google photos. It also has some great feature's that are free for the most part. It's very easy to keep it organized, If you have a gmail account or Google drive it's very quick and easy to sync or upload all of your media on to them. All things considered i was impressed and have no complaints about it whatsoever as it was free.

The photos were not the issue, only that once you try to sync it's impossible to stop them from syncing. I tried to figure out how when I ran out of storage (stop making video clips with my photos that take up more room) & the instructions I finally found were not correct. Finally uninstalled the app after downloading them to my laptop.

Not sure if this is part of some financial strategy or a bug but: I've ordered a photo book month ago. And in order to do so I had to select photos and "wizard" organized them in book. It was cool cause I've selected 76 photos (book can have 100 pages) but algorithm did some magic by creating collages etc. So I was like 6-7 pages more than basic book. Now, after a month, same s enario, different photos and I get photo per page. Had to do all the work on my own which wasn't so easy because of poo

If you want this app to backup your photos, there are better ways. If your photos are organized in folders, backup does not preserve your folders. Instead, you have thousands of photos all together. If you ever have to restore them from the backup, you will have to sort them out one by one! That means creating new folders on your device, finding each photo individually, then adding them to your newly created device folders. Believe me or not.

I've had a pretty good experience through the years... Until now. Supposedly after I bought said storage I wouldn't have to worry it. Obviously that was just talk. A large amount of my photos have up and disappeared. Nothing like paying for something and not getting it, huh?

Even though I really don't utilize Google Photos very often I was just shown the latest tweeks and updates so I am intuitive on changing that. I know the assistant isn't a Newbie but very helpful. The mindblower is The Infinity amount of data Google is giving anybody and everybody so we'll stay on their leesh, and the album's I didn't even know I had. Wow, it makes my phone gallery resemble a photo album from the 80's I dig it and I have no choice but to love it 👊

Extremely difficult to use. There is no function to "move" a picture into an album! If you click on pictures and they are in albums, then they show up as doubles, I had my past holiday pictures sorted by year, now they are all togeather 🤯😡🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬. I hate how the Google photos operates. Dont bother using it unless you don't have an option!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The app is being more and more strict about making a user switch to cloud. To download a set of backed up photos on phone, you can only do it one by one. I spent last 2 hours figuring out how to do it, but they have already made life so much harder. Looking for another app to manage photos from now on.

Uninstalled app and reinstalled and it's back to normal. I like that have choices to change lighting, color, darken or lighten background. Lastly, the ability to pop the picture more of less. Went to other apps and could use only what they had for color, brightness and could not change from lighter or darker background. Here's a quote, "if it's not broken don't fix it".

I think it's awesome to have free unlimited high quality compressed photo backups. I also love the automatic effects. Sometimes it randomly makes an animation out of your photos, other times it's a slideshow with music. I just like being surprised by these little extras when they happen. The auto adjust feature is pretty good. I often use it first and then adjust the settings more myself and find that it's quite a bit faster than doing it all from scratch.

After reading other reviews I see I'm not alone in some of my frustration with the app. For the most part I truly enjoy it but I'm waiting like patience on a monument over here for pictures I need that were snapped with my phone or tablet camera to upload. I'd like to be able to label or name my photos easier too. Why can't we organize gifs quicker & easier? Dates are good but names/labels would be easier. When I need a picture I need to know I can quickly & easily locate it and move on.

Photos in albums are put there to organize and reduce clutter, yet duplicates are still there in the main pool which still leaves the main pool cluttered and confusing. Photos in albums shouldn't be displayed in the main pool because you can find them in their respective album. Photos in albums should retain their date and place shot of course.

Great to be able to access my phone photos from any device. Update - 5 years on: I've now got 1000s of photos & upgraded to paid storage. However the only way to add that info is in the description & that's useless as it isn't searchable 😣

I was using my phone gallery for photos, but this offers a lot of features that I find myself using more and more. I love the way it sorts faces and you can name them and then just search for the person or animal (yes, animals!) that you want to find pictures of. I took a group photo at work with around 40 people and it added each face in the photo. I couldn't believe it. Pretty amazing Google! Now if you could just add something to color my black and white photos. That'd be awesome!

I really enjoy the photo features with collages, etc. My only complaint would be that when trying to update (for months now), the app seems to freeze in the download pending phase. And everytime that I pull up photos, I am faced with the update now or not now that I have to choose. It's just frustrating.

You can't put photos into folders like you used to be able to. I have hundreds of thousands of pictures. How am I supposed to organize them? They are completely and totally unmanageable. If your photos are in albums on your phone, they'll be dumped into one location when they're uploaded. If you want to scroll back to like 2016 it will take about 45 minutes, IF you don't accidentally click back to today's date. You can't organize your photos in Drive anymore, either. They said that was too confusing. They could have added an advanced "View Photos in Drive" toggle to let superusers turn that feature on so we could easily move photos into folders, but they don't want you to be able to move your photos to a new service easily. It worked. I wish I'd used literally any other service. I hate Google Photos

I have loved this app, having used it for about 7 years now. I have saved literally thousands of photos, and organized them into albums. I also like being able to edit (to some degree) within this app, without having to do it with a separate program. The only negative about it is that when I changed my email address, thousands of photos and all of my albums disappeared. I later found them, after finding how to go into the app under my old email address. Would be great if you could merge the two

The new version is terrible, I really liked the For You section, which is now gone. Everything now takes more clicks and it's really highlighting the option to order photos. I take a lot of photos and normally print very few. Trying to sell me on ordering photo books is pointless. I'd like the previous version back.

Hands down the best photo service currently amongst icloud, Dropbox, amazon etc. Just works. It's even better if you take pics from multiple devices they all show up in the same place. Assistant is good too, but is more of a me too feature. Good basic editing features too. And many more that most users will never use. The sharing feature ie album sharing could do some more work. It's very confusing right now and not straightforward. It doesn't need to be so. The only other ask is to allow high res / original quality uploads. Highly recommended. Boo on Apple for not even coming close and asking so much money to do basic sync of photos across devices.

I love that this app saves all the photographs I take, so I never accidentally lose a cherished moment I captured "on film." Digital film, I guess. But I hate how it saves bagillions of the same photo. Maybe it's my settings, but still, no excuse for a company like Google.  Surely they see all the details of each photo/video. We should be given the option to duplicate or overwrite... That's my suggestion anyway.

I really dislike the most recent update. sorting things into "collections" I feel like I can't find my photos. literally, I'll take a screenshot, then look at the "screenshot" collection and it's not there. I can't find photos I had no problem finding before. it needs to be changed back. ------------:----I got a response to this saying collections help find things easier. they do not. The photos I used to find quickly, I have to dig just to find.

Don't order prints! There's no way to get help when you're order is messed up or MISSING. Part of my order never showed it was even shipped out! I got charged for it and 2 weeks later still hasn't showed up . I received all my other prints in a few days. BTW they all come from different states. With one size each. 8x10 one shipment, 5x7 one shipment, ect.. App is good for storing your photos just not in order of date taken most of the time. Anyway, I will never order anything again!

Under normal circumstances, the app behaves fine. It's convenient and easy to use. However, the recent update has completely broken the app on my Samsung Galaxy S20. I can't view file information or share files directly from the app anymore, which drastically cuts down on the convenience factor. I'm hoping this will be fixed in a future update so that I can edit this review.

**update: all problems listed below are fixed. If they can get rid of these mysterious ghost like bugs I'd give it 5 stars.

It's pretty basic. I do like the tools and filters available for free as well as the ones you have to pay for. The price is low, however it irritates me that Google (being the billionaires that they are) decided to charge their loyal customers for certain features within the photos app. I find it to be unnecessary as they make PLENTY of money already thru so many other things, they could have just let it all be free. Other than that, the app can be confusing when you're trying to organize pics.

Love it but there are things I don't quite understand. Albums: there's has to be sorting options. You can only see the photos chronologically. I have shared albums with my family. We upload there photos we really like and it's getting crowded. I get a notification when someone upload a new photo to one of those albums and I have to scroll manually to the bottom. And that's the other thing about albums. There's no scroll bar within albums. Everything else in the app has scroll bar and I'm waiting to see it implemented as well on albums. I've already asked it months ago in a feedback. The other thing, minor but useful too, is that i wish I could tag people in order to see them when I select their faces. There are some photos that it doesn't recognize their faces and sometimes I'd like to tag a person just because that's their back

The latest update is terrible and it has made editing pictures worse and more time-consuming. It takes much longer to make adjustments whereas before you could fix pictures more quickly and accurately. The screen looks completely busy and cluttered when you go into editing mode and you can't see all the settings at a quick glance like before. I have no idea how anyone could have approved this awful change to a once great app.

I love using gphotos. I am not an advanced user... just someone who has a phone with very little storage, so the ability to automatically store in the cloud is critical. The only feature I'd like to see added is the ability to organize items in the same way that other Google services do... with tags/labels. I've tried to use albums for this purpose, but it's not meant for that and gets too difficult to manage as the number of albums increases.

I was hoping that the Googles Photos App had some easy option to both preserve our memories in two ways. (Maybe I missed some kind of option when exploring the settings..idk...) ...but.. If i build up a few album's that'd have more than 800 photos in, also a few music files, video files, albums of saved gameplay...ect I like the storage. Itd be nice if we could choose how and what is being uploaded. -Upload Photo Quality- ·Original ·High ·Med ·Low Like that ☝

I'm a picture fiend. And this helps save the most precious moments!!! Update: as of the new update, my sharing partner And I have been receiving notifications of nxes photos, except when we open the notification, it say "sorry this link is not available, either you lost connection or url expired" ... I have connection, nothing I know of is due to expire and neither of us and shared anything within a few days; frustrating .

this is all I use now, and the biggest thing for me is that it keeps my photos synced across all my devices, instantly, every time I take a new photo... but one of the coolest features is when it makes collages and animations for you. That's what made me decide to give it the rating, after just looking through some of the things it created on its own.

Would be good if I could manually label photos the AI hasn't recognized. Like photos of people or pets that haven't been labeled. "Unlimited" storage is misleading, although it's still a great deal. You can only upload a limited amount of photos in their original quality, though I think the unlimited quality is plentifully high for most people.

This has got to be the most unintuitive difficult to use photos app. Even if this is your default photo library, it's near impossible to find anything. Editing a photo and saving a copy is useless, as it won't even show up in the app, it'll save as a file on your device. I really do love this app and the security of knowing my photos are backed up and accessible from everywhere. Although it frequently gets it wrong or makes weird things, the auto suggested collages, animations, videos, etc are frequently fun. I do wish that the collage maker allowed for a little bit more control (photo cropping, placement, order, etc) like the old Picassa app used to have. And it is still very cumbersome to correct misidentified faces. But aside from that, it's a great app!

The 3 problems I have are when the photo of someone's face is in the wrong face id folder, you can't move them to another one or create a new one. Second is if you take burst photo, you should be able to make an animation out of it, if you can do that than my phone just won't let me. I miss being able to correct red eyes in my phone's own editor rather than having to download some 3rd party thing that puts a watermark. If these 3 issues were addressed then 5 stars, otherwise I love the app.

I love it because one, it automatically backs up my photos, and as someone who has lost photos before because of a device breaking down or corrupting, this means the world to me. Then two, I love being able to search for specific things whether it be people, pets, objects, or other things. It's saved me so much headaches I could've had like when searching for things I need as reference for something at work because it recognizes practically anything in a picture.

I wish I had more control to make GIFs, montages, collages, etc. but I'm always grateful every time one is auto generated (if the user could have control over this, perhaps making it easier to access). It would be nice to be able to apply fonts with shadows and GoogleDocs-like control over text, spacing, alignment, so that I could just make memes here. Docs took away my insistence on Word, and this could take away many others insistence on relying on other apps for their picture altering needs.

Have been using this app for the past year or so. It's been great! can't say enough about it. Everything including updates that regularly improve the app itself, easy to use self syncing, automatically sorts the junk photos and suggests which ones to use. As a small business man who's work includes the taking of many photos from 3-5 different devices on a regular basis this app not only does it all but does it all for you. Thanks Google. top marks from this customer !😉👍

Add the option to rename the photos/videos (which are no longer in our devices) added to albums, please! And the option to add tags to the photos/videos, so that way we could easily find them, because a lot of times certain words doesn't give any result or we want to find photos of a particular person, please. This app could be amazing but it needs a lot of fixing!

For a while, I saw Google Photos as nothing more than an alternative to my system's default photo gallery app. Now I see it as so much more though. It is helpful to have photos backed up to the cloud to free up space on my phone. The intelligent features in the app are very helpful at times. It is great to be able to search my photos by location, by person, or (as I just found out) by object! The facial recognition is not perfect, but it is very good!

After the latest update, backing up photos now takes forever and even before that, there is always a problem. The app would get stuck in a "getting ready to back up" loop. I've tried all the fixes from clearing caches, to clearing data, to deleting and reinstalling the app, and this fixes the problem for a while, but eventually something goes wrong again. For an app made by Google, this is a very disappointing app.

Photo management is complete chaos. Cant control where they go, how to move, how to keep in a private area, move or copy independently of all devices, how to access albums... then photos show up in multiple folders, and if you archive something, guess you have just deleted it. Easy photo mgmt software has existed for decades, this ain't it. Took a simple thing and complicated beyond belief. It's a nightmare. I'm pissed. You suck Google photos.

I was extremely happy with his app, but the fact that they're planning to discontinue the free unlimited storage makes me think I should get another way to back up my items, like an external kind of memory. Isn't fair that something that started free now decides to charge a fee without thinking or caring about the customers that can't pay. I'll uninstall and stop using once the change takes place.

Easy to use. Always backs up all my photos and is easy to find out what has been backed up and what hasn't. I love that even though I delete them off my phone I can always pull them back up on the app. No need to re-download them just to show pictures to friends or share them! Love the freedom of freeing up space on my phone.

The July 2025 update to Google Photos is much harder to use than the previous version and some of the old functionality (like freeform cropping) doesn't even work on the new version. Options are spread across a range of different "buttons" so are harder to find, and adjustment sliders are far too sensitive, making small adjustments very difficult. Unless you only want to apply standard filters to your photos you'll find yourself having to look elsewhere for a different tool to edit your photos.

The "favorites" star randomly appears sometimes. When it does, I'm unable to move any photo to another folder. I like the star, because it allows me to flag a photo that I want to keep, and mass delete other ones I don't. But it would be nice to be able to have it around all the time and also be able to use the move to folder feature. Also there's a new error that says photos doesn't have access to my SD card to delete a photo.

My photos aren't in the app. Some appear but 99% can only be accessed from my Files app. Sorting is just bad (no sub folders is a pain for someone with many pictures). When editing, you can only "Save as copy" so you have to delete the original after editing. The only feature I needed and used (adjusting pictures of documents) became premium and now I can only rely on the "Automatic" button. Wish I could delete this app but it's preinstalled. Gotta find a decent gallery app additionally now.

It in (almost) every way is like the desktop version to the application and then some. I say almost because two things I want the app to do. Technically the desktop version, but I want the option to edit videos on desktop. The other is the slideshow feature on the app. It works PERFECTLY on desktop (especially with videos) but the app does no such thing. That's why I cannot give it any higher than 3 stars. I hope you see this Google as a reason to update the software.

I would give it zero stars if I could. I hate the updates. constantly prompting me to send and print photos with adds. pushing AI to to rearrange my photos if I want to arrange them my way . This app is great. You can see all your photos and it is better than any default android gallery and it's really handy to back up your photos. The problem is that it is extremely hard to organise your photos. For example there is no way to delete a photo from the cloud without deleting it from your phone as well. WE NEED THIS FUNCTION GOOGLE! If this feature was added this would easily be 5 stars.

The app is incredible. Knowing that I have access to photos long gone from my gallery is amazing. HOWEVER, the new policy, which puts an end to free unlimited storage is a big big bummer. My biggest pet peeve is the lack of providing decent photo editing. I'm not looking for Photoshop or even 'Photoshop 3.0', I used 1994. I like the ability to group people, things and places in so many ways automatically. Google gets it right pretty often. Infuriating to use. Does not let you see the filename. Does not let you change how it names the file. File name does not match any other app. It has the ability to edit video..... I absolutely love Google photos. It kept all of my photos and videos safe and secure throughout the year. But now I've got to pay a monthly subscription for more space. This is my second Pixel (Pixel 3XL). the main thing that made me go for this was the photos (and the ability to choose what apps I want on my phone.) Google may not be perfect, but they show a knack for identifying what we really want & need to work well- and making it do that...

Why is it that Google took away the most useful feature of this app from Android but left it for Apple? I legit photograph everything! So my phone has a tendency to get bogged down by photos and videos. lots of cool features. some easier to use than others. my favorite feature is being able to order any photos you want in app for . 18 cents each for regular sized prints and the more you get the less you pay in shipping until u reach free shipping for 20 + photos I think. you get them fast. they have special offers for first time orders and periodically promotions. my one complaint is all the duplicates it allows Everytime it backs up ur photos. if the name changes on them it misses doubles.

Love that all my photos and videos are in one place, and especially love how it puts videos, pic collages, and pop up memories together for You! Its been fixed. I find that if I am out of date and not current with updates this pops up again. However it is nothing like it was. The grouping tools are awesome too. My experience is now 4.5 stars, but it took me so long to get here. Would it be an impossible ask for Google to not move the photos around but leave them alone in the order they were taken? I really, really like PHOTOS 2015 Im adding to this. Google photos has been the top of all the photo apps I've used. I have used it over the years and it remains the best. I love using Google Photos. This app is excellent for uploding photos with unlimited storage. The app also has a search bar that you can use to quickly locate photos of the same topics, for example you can search the word, 'dog' and all the pictures you have of any dogs will show up. I highly recommend this app 10/10. It is so fun and easy to use. Thanks Google. 😁

A video I uploaded years ago suddenly couldn't be downloaded. Now it won't play at all on any devices. I've filled tickets everywhere I could find, even on Facebook, but no one bothers contacting me. UPDATED REVIEW: I've used this app for years now. It manages to store & organize my pictures without losing them. My house burnt down awhile ago. I lost many [physical] photographs as a result of water damage. Due to Google Photos, I have pictures I wouldn't have had beforehand. However, I made a huge mistake. I thought I backed up everything from the home computer which melted in the fire. I lost years of pictorial memories, as I didn't back them up. Lesson Learned!

Not at all what I thought it was. I downloaded this after Google image search stopped letting me save directly off of the search, thinking Photos would solve that issue. That's not the case here. My phone's gallery app works just fine. I don't need Google to be a data cloud, fully knowing that my images are being used for other data-gathering purposes. There are better clouds for that. No thank you.

Poor. The Album function displays photos in random sequence, not in the order I choose, and removes photos from the album when I try to rearrange them. I've reported this issue to Google repeatedly, to no avail. Another issue: there used to be a way to starred photos as "Favorites" but that feature appears to be gone and all the photos I had starred as "Favorites" are no longer so. There are other issues but these two are the most serious ones for me Seeking alternatives to this product.

Bad UX. Saved a modified version of a not-so-recent photo from an album? Good luck finding it ever again in the whole feed. Trying to export a photo to another folder so that it's easier to find in other apps? You can't. Upload dialog blocking UI waiting for network? Tough luck, now you can't use the app until you have network again or kill it. Can't add selection of photos to more than one album. Can't see what albums a photo is already part of.

The auto-upload photo storage is wonderful. The AI adds a lot of searchability but can be inconsistent about faces. Most troublesome is that if Google fails to see a face where one is, there is no option to highlight and name the person. Overall, it's nice to have a backup in full resolution, but when it have to update content that you backed up anfd then you edit on the phone, like a slow motion video, Photo is the worse. It wont update and no matter what you do on the phone, if you try to download the video, it will be downloaded the entire video on slow motion, not the section you would want.

I instantly, regret, paying for storage, just to see how bad this is when it comes to selecting photos and overall systems compared to the actual gallery from the original device. I love this app. My phone doesn't have a regular photo gallery, so I didn't have much of a choice, but I was pleasantly surprised. When I got my phone I disabled all of the pre-installed Google apps that I don't use, but recently a friend sent me some important pictures through this app so I re-enabled it. I just used the option to free up space and now the app it's just a mess of unorganized photos sorted by date only. Great app! Very easy to synchronize between cell phone and laptop. Google photos is amazing. The app never crashes. Automatic upload of all my photos. Super cheap and well worth it to upgrade and add extra storage. The fact that it recognizes faces (I can save the names of everyone in my photos) and I can search for literally anything and it'll find it is hands down the most convenient and mind blowing aspect. Best gallery app ever! But don't sell it short, it's so much more than a simple gallery. I never have to worry about losing photos as they are automatically backed up. Ok,how about this. Not sure why I have to update the storage device for my pictures. All in all not a bad app BUT, and there's always a but 1. When I make a collage I'd like to pick from a few different templates to show off these photos. It's all the same even with different photos.
