If you use the backup and sync tool on a PC to upload photos, there is no way to get photos downloaded on your PC. Google photos seems more like a photo dump because of this than actual photo service.

I love the app, I think it's super intuitive and a great tool. I'm slightly biased because I love just about everything made by Google, but the photos app is one of their best works. I wish they could improve the name groupings. Sometimes the "unknowns" area grouped but not all of the same person and I can't separate them. But nonetheless, a great app.

I really enjoyed using Google Photos, until the backup feature got stuck, with an endless loop of "Getting ready to back up". There's not a lot of information on what to do when this happens - I've tried force stopping the app, clearing the cache and clearing the data - it only made the problem worse with 1 photo stuck now being 62 photos stuck. For those who aren't technologically literate, this issue would be a nightmare to fix, and would break the back up feature. You would think for an app that you pay for (to buy storage), things would be better.

The feature list is amazing, but even with the latest Pixel phone, the app just keeps getting slower and slower. Searching typically takes so long I give up, it won't delete backed up photos, new photos take hours to show up, and I have switched to Gallery Go for viewing photos on my phone. I did a factory reset on my phone, and not even that helped. I am looking for an alternative.

UPDATE: reducing from 3 to 2. Photos makes neat collages etc. I click on a notification to see one. Wait too long, poof it's gone. Random slideshow starts, no way to find the collages. Didn't save in time. Reducing from 5 to 3. The backup is solid. But I hate the new galleries / "this date x years ago" view. I can't zoom, I'm always fighting it going forward and backward, and it skips off to other years. I find myself fighting the UI and frustrated with it almost always when viewing.

Getting better, but still unclear when it comes to accessing different directories, It doesn't seem able to find images, even when you tell it where to look. Kind of laggy on pixel 3. new editing interface is difficult to use, and makes the picture so small that it's hard to see what changes might have happened. just once I would like an app to be designed by people who actually might use it at some time.

Overall the app functions fine, but I find that I have trouble with organization. Editing is a breeze and even fun, though I really need to edit with the awesome pixel camera. I need an option to select (and delete or move) ALL photos from a certain location, or say, find all photos with dogs in them. I know how to search, but results are hit or miss. With over 300K photos, organization is a nightmare. Don't want to buy storage. Please increase organization and mass location select.

Please put back "View Recent Activity". Was very helpful for shared albums. Also I was able to at one point have my photos backed up without having to always go into the Photos app. It no longer does that. It will only back up photos if we go into the app. Please put it back the setting where it will automatically back up photos if we do not go into the app. App is no longer syncing with my photos in Google photos on the desktop. There are photos shown there that aren't shown on my phone app.

When you back your slowmo videos into photos and delete it off of your device, it makes the whole video in slowmotion instead of just the part you edited. This has been a problem for years, and they still havent fixed it. The app is really easy to use, and the Assistant makes it easy to find photos from trips. It automatically makes slideshows. Also recently, when I back up videos, I can't view them

Excellent App!! I can't say enough good things about it. I have been using Google photos for over 12 years and I love that my photos are always backed up and easily accessible, not matter what happens to my phone's or cameras. I love all the choices to edit the photos and love being able to make memorial videos! The only thing I don't like is that you can't add text or drawings to pictures like you can in other photo editing apps.

Inconsistent interface. E.g., some contexts allow for larger photo thumbnails while others do not. So if there are multiple photos of the same scene, it is difficult to pick the best one because the thumbnail is too small. The album sharing feature is a poor effort. When trying to share, not all users presented by Photos can be invited and Photos does not offer an explanation.

I like Google Photos a lot, I've used it for several years. The cloud backup and partner sharing are pretty seamlessly integrated, and the app as a whole is quite simple to use. The in app editing features could use a total overhaul, they're boring, unimpressive, and not very well executed, but that's the lowest point as far as I'm concerned. It is great for photo storage, sharing, and making albums easily, but in app editing isn't noteworthy at all. Definitely get a separate app for that.

Just awesome! The automatic stories are great (the dates might be a little off if you are on a different time zone) the ability to find old photos by date, or people (as long as you tag them) and places (as long as your GPS indicator is turned on in your camera). And the ability to edit photos and share them with your friend for them to download, without having to create a bunch of emails is great!

Great photo storage, managing, editing, viewing and sharing app. Only one thing could make it better... the ability to show only photos that you haven't added to your albums - so you can see which ones still don't have a 'home' - either as a fixed feature, or one that can be toggled on or off. This way, you'll know which photos have not been 'categorised'.

This app does a great job storing pictures and has many other cool features (collages, animating, etc.). Unfortunately, due to limited space on my phone and the massive amount of photos I take, I had to part ways with this app. It was taking over 2.5 GB on my storage card and I just couldn't handle my phone giving me warnings about running out of room. I did everything I could to make room but to no avail. It would also run hard on my battery if I took a lot of photos, so the cons outweigh pros.

This has been my go to photo storage solution for nearly five years since it was released. I have to downgrade it from 5 to 3 stars, however, for two reasons. 1) the free photo storage option for compressed "high quality" photos is being removed, and this just about kills the usefulness of this app. 2) the improvement in features over the last five years has been really minimal. I really expected the app to be a lot further along by this point, tons of features missing.

I love the feature of backing EVERY SINGLE PHOTO on all my devices. I wish the app had a "Favorite" feature to get to all my best pics easier, however. I really like the Assistant that creates collages, movies, animations, albums, etc. but I wish you could edit them to change out certain images (and perhaps change that awful music it adds to the movies).

Easy access to pics on phone and computer, easy to use, enjoy their stylized pics, and memories. Not great for labeling pics, which would make it easier to reference or find later. Also would prefer to have better options for making collage, putting the pics in the specific spot I want them in. It needs improved searching for specific pics. Would like option to make a movie/slide show in the sequence I put photos in an album. And with more than 50 photos.

Free unlimited storage of high quality photos is a great thing in itself, but it's so much more. The auto creation of animations, panorama's, stylised photos etc. is fun, as well as being transported back to good old memories with 'Remember This Day'. It's also a reliable and simple way to create a shared album where everyone can put their photos from a particular event in the same place for all to enjoy!

Pics are great, takes forever to make a custom movie. Movies don't allow you to pick which part of video you want, so usually adds an unwanted segment or cuts off the head. Editing video feature would be great. Now Google put a limit on storage, they want you to buy storage so they can be like Apple, so that sucks now, I'll have to move photos to Dropbox more, I guess. But overall app is pretty good.

As all Google Apps never disappointed, just as an FYI: even better when paired with, Adobe Photoshop Express App!! I sh#@&- not! Most Excellent... Options and ability to clear up any fuzzyness etc. Not to mention the ability to do things with your pictures that you may or may not have even considered!!! I was awestruck by the blending of the 2... Enjoy

It"s brilliant. The more you find out about it, the better it gets. Except for the lack of ability to sort Albums by anything other than date. Why on earth can't each photo be moved up or down the list, so you can arrange them exactly how you want them. This facility exists widely in other applications, why not in Google photos. Marking down a star because of this.

The new update makes the app unfortunately cumbersome to use. I liked having all of my pictures in one area, and being able to exclude libraries when necessary. Now, different folders are segregated and I have to go to library and find the photo folders I use most often. Cannot find a way to change this. Will be switching applications to something more usable and streamlined.

The positive, SD cards can & do fail so irreplaceable media like photos are always backed up. The negative. It wants access to my SD card when I try to delete photos that are backed up in the cloud, there are photos I have no need to back up, that go into a separate folder on my phone. The app gives me an option to only save from certain folders, but I can't be sure if I allow access it won't 'find' that folder, & delete from it. I'd prefer to have the option of deleting from the cloud only.

Of all the photo apps that I have tried, on Android phones, many of which I have struggled with and uninstalled because they were just too bloated and the interface was not conducive to the app. However, this photo app has none of those glitches or problems. I feel that this app is the best so far. The only thing I think that any photo app makes a mistake with is giving the photographer too many options some of which are patently ridiculous. Not all of us want to make our head into a triangle!

Welp, it's great, but if you shoot sports at high frame rates it totally sucks. It will not put your photos in chronological order if the shot-to-shot time is less than 1 second. When I shoot at 10 frames per second the sequence shows out of order. Please fix this and I'll give more stars. Until then, 1 star... Update Oct 2021: The photos are now in order, except when they are in an album. For some reason, the albums didn't get the chronological update like the main photos did. Almost there.

I've never really had an issue with App until today. I finally decided to try and create an animation as well as a collage. Very disappointing!! The animation speed was crazy fast with no options to change it. No additional transition themes. Actually, no options for editing at all!! Unfortunately, same issue with the collage. No frames to choose from. No themes or colors. I couldn't even adjust the photos positioning in provided frame to fit correctly. I guess ya get what ya get.. 🤷🏼‍♀️

Used to be a set and forget type of app that would upload photos taken to google photos, but this feature hasn't worked for me for a few weeks now. Instead, it displays a message that says it is 'getting ready to upload'. Despite the message, it never actually uploads anything. I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling app, and clearing cache, but nothing has worked so far.

Good app, but it could use some improvements comparing it to the iOS version. 1) it's very hard to know what pictures/videos are synced already. Please add an icon to the thumbnail to know if it's synched or not. Otherwise the app works great. The "ease of use" could improve. Arranging stuff seems very difficult, especially if you haven't arranged your Media in past uploads.

Major problem with zoom. After viewing photo with zoom it is highly likely to hang. The bug quite easily reproduced, just open photo zoom in, then zoom out, then go to next photo and repeat. I'm not able to watch 10 photos this way and I need to close the program and reopen it. As result, the process of cleaning photos is a nightmare. Please make it easier and faster. Please also do some speed optimization for adding a photo to an album.A very nice to have feature: a list of albums photo belongs

It deletes some of your downloaded/saved photos. Also, around 50 of my photos have just turned black, no matter what device I look from. I can't see what they are anymore. And now on my android, I can only view some of my photos in my library. The rest are gone completely. This all is good in viewing your photos from different devices (linked to your gmail), but it doesn't keep all of them. I don't know what's happening (this all happened within 1 day), but can you please fix it

You are trying to do too much. Too much OVERREACH into my phone and my pictures. Although some of the features are nifty, not everyone wants their stuff whisked off into the cloud and automatic grouping and such. Too much potential for my photos to go where no man has gone before. Please consider recoding to be more considerate of the fact that some people may just want to manually manage their data! ASK Atomically, Explain clearly, Authorize individually

I use Photos on a daily basis and see myself using it as long as I'm taking pictures, which will be the rest of my life. There are so many options that I still haven't used it to it's full potential. I love how it identifies by people's faces, searches for them if you need, even creates memory books with the option to order a printed hard cover copy (paid, of course), allows you to free up space on your phone by deleting originals. I pay willingly for storage for that option.

Used to be great, until it started crashing every single time I used it... Now it just keeps popping up messages that it's stopped working even when I'm not using it. The definition of a nuisance app. The only reason I still keep it is that it still backs up my photos so I can at least still look at albums and creations on my computer. Update: the app seems outdated and complicated to navigate. You think they'd have streamlined it by now.

I love the surprises from the photo assistant -memories, special effects, collages and more! And the automatic upload. I didn't give 5 stars because: although the search usually gives adequate results, it sometimes yields nothing on a keyword that should be simple enough (or totally wrong results) , and albums are difficult to search. I would like to be able to handle my albums, and see them, as easily add I did in Picasa. For example, I had to create 4 albums with the same name, because when I w

this is my main photo and video keeper. Can't edit photos after current update (happens a lot to me for unknown reasons). With my pictures that I lost i tried to recover so many times but it has a different number on it (did save current number, did try everything but lost everything.) Would be nice to watch videos and view pictures without connection. There are times that videos that don't want to play ( says can't play ), just annoys me.

This app... Let's say that I had a lot of problems while using this app. Firstly, I couldn't edit pictures due to a certain error; secondly, whenever I moved my photos to my new album, it didn't show up as if the app didn't know that these images were in the said album; lastly, the compression after I trimmed the video was definitely unnecessary. With this in mind, I hope you guys will take action against these problems.

I love this app, it has a lot of great features and has been storing my images for years. However I have had 1 consistent problem, albums. Whenever I make an album and put my photos there I don't want to see it on my main reel of photos anymore. I can never actually finish organizing all of them if the ones I've already categorized are still in the way. I even pay monthly for extra storage.

It is not okay to force-update my phone to Android 16, where I am certain someone had to know that it is not going to work on the Pixel 6. Crashing. Overheating. if you can name it then I have experienced it. It is basically a way to try to get people to spend money and get a new phone. I think that's a pretty poor way of doing business.

If it had not been for Google Photos, I would have lost so many photos to the ether. The facial recognition technology is crazy accurate! However, app is a little slow, even on the fastest internet connection. It's also not very user-friendly. While this one doesn't exactly apply to myself, less tech savvy people may have trouble navigating. Otherwise, it's a great app & I love that I don't have to worry about losing my pics...and I do have a lot of them!

Would be great to have better video editing capabilities. The "create auto movie" feature doesn't work all the time. The photo editing features are much better than they used to be but still not as dynamic as they could be. The auto-enhance seems to just usd a Vivid filter without any real color/tone/contrast adjustments based on reading the image. This and the subpar auto crop feature is why I keep Photoshop Express (PE) installed. PE is so much more advanced at auto adjustments.

There's a lot of good here, especially the editing features. But photo organization lags behind other options. You can't edit photos within an album: You need to find the photo in your main library instead. You also can't download photos from albums (same issue). I really like most of the app and would love to give it more, but the library organization capabilities really make it inconvenient at times.
This app saved my life, it's really amazing and useful, make sure you install it. 👍

I had my photos neatly organized in folders with descriptive names. I just got a new phone. Google Photos "said" it had backed up my photos. It had, but in the process it flattened the folder structure, deleted the few custom albums I had and, to my suprise, even emptied out albums it had created. I tried to recreate the albums, but found it impossible to do a search and then select all the results. Worse, the sort order in my first attempt was random, with the album completely ignoring the dates of the photos. Awful app.

I used to love this app, especially for the editing tools. They were easy to use and quick to navigate. Now the photo editing is basically just more AI slop. Trying to manually edit photos is nearly impossible and takes ages thanks to the changes to menus and burying every functionality EXCEPT the AI ones. Just horrendous changes. The entire reason I've bought Pixels for several years was for the Google camera and photo apps. I'll be looking at other options next time I need to upgrade.

Just recently the multiple framing, sizing & color choices were eliminated for creating collages, (on my Android) Unless these functions were bundled into a different app that was the one of the only things I liked about Photos. Making an album is dull, boring, if you want to create fun, you have to purchase a Photo Book. This is really a greedy move, Google. (I will amend if I find out I'm incorrect about the blaise` collage thing)

Update 11/30/19 Google photos is no longer auto generating albums for me or collages for me to save, since this past spring. I absolutely loved that feature and am so disappointed it's not available to me anymore. ‐------------------------- I love that my pictures are backed up to google photos. I like the Google assistant and the rediscover this day feature. I like being able to go into the app and find pics from June 2013 (or whenever) so easy!

The almost perfect mobile app for photography. What I still missing are the followings: 1) making local adjustments with a brush (darken, lighten a particular area of the photograph) 2) if I edit a photo book, it would be nice to be able to edit an inserted photograph (sometimes some more adjustments are needed because photos on the same place have different color temperatures or lightness) 3) perspective correction tool would be useful 4) giving more stars to photos than only one would be great.

Very poor options for a high quality photo app. 1. Photos in an album cannot be ordered bared in name of the photos 2. When you upload old photos they go into the photos based on time,date they are taken.need to scroll all the way to the last few years when the photo was taken even though it's upload now. 3. ability to upload a folder directly onto the album is missing. it's so irritating to select each photo into the album. 4. ordering multiple photos in an album at once fails most of the time.

I love the ease of use, and how I don't need to concern myself about back ups of my photos collection. Worrying about hyper-organizing my pictures is no longer on my radar. I'd love to see more investment into the Assistant feature, though, as I feel like their suggestions are becoming more rare - even though I tend to save each one and look forward to some new cool creation that Google has imagined with my photos.

This went from a great app to a bad one so fast. I have been a Google Photos user for a long time and I have three major problems: 1) You cannot sync your photos with your computer anymore. 2) Videos seem to randomly get compressed from time to time, and cannot be properly recovered from Google Takeout. 3) Facial recognition flat out doesn't work most of the time. It won't even attempt many of my photos. I've spent hours on the phone with Google One support with no fix, and it's not just me.

It's all your photos cataloged in more ways than you need. With more options then you realize. Confusing to the point of brainless simplicity. Smooth. Colorful. Intuitive. Complicated. Garish. Rough. I couldn't be happier with it. It's saved many photos through many phone loses. Thanks and praises to the beautiful people at Google.

A very good way to manage ALL your photos from anywhere on any device. I tell my friends about it because its so delightful being able to browse my entire collection of photos on my phone. Its cool to skim through old photos and go back in time anywhere. Google photos is the solution to digital photo chaos. *edit. Deleting photos from the sd card - currently not working for me. *Edit. Suddenly not as useful as a gallery app when you cannot integrate it with other cloud storage options.

There is no easy way to re-download images that may have been deleted back onto your phone. I didn't realize what the "clean up" feature was, and assumed it would be tool to clean up storage in the app. It's impossible to easily re-download those photos, there isn't a button or menu at all. Upsetting problem to deal with, as i do not use photos as my main photo manager.

The new July 2020 Photos is a disappointment. The photo backup & web gallery continue to be great. However the 1-year-ago or 3-year-ago auto-collection presentation is terrible. The previous version was like looking thru a photo album. The current version is more like TV. The back/forward, slideshow & magnifier controls are limited -- you will see what the app wants to show you at its pace. I think I will turn off the notifications.

They've ruined the quick photo editing ability I loved so much. Instead of being able to adjust the settings and play around with them together to get the look I want, I now have to click into each one, adjust it, then come back out, then adjust the next one and so on. It also takes a while to load the editing controls, whereas before it was almost instant. This is such a massive step backwards. Not at all usable and will be looking for a new photo app.

Update: I use this as my primary photo storage. It does what it needs to, I just wish I could download photos easier than 1 at a time on my phone. Also apparently the storage settings are changing so I guess I gotta pull out the hard drive and slowly start moving my pictures. I don't want to pay monthly for extra storage. If it was a one and done payment option, I might do it.

Not a fan of having to save a copy of enhanced photos. I used to enhance nearly all my photos, and now if I do I'll end up with double the photos or having to go through to delete them all. Yet I can enhance photos in my web browser without having to save a copy. Horrible change. I do really like the magic eraser though. My pictures from touristy areas look much nicer without people.

I love a lot about it. It's easy to organize photos, share, and the memory reminders great! The things that bother me is not being able to search within an album and not being able to automatically add photos to an album only if 2 people I choose are in it together. Please add the options. Another odd thing is the photo it auto selected to be the main photo of a person is terrible. It used to be one of me with my eyes half closed and now it's a really bad photo of me from 20 years ago.

I used to like this app quite a bit and still like a lot of it's simple but effective edit capabilities. However, several months ago, it lost the ability to delete photos (keeps asking for permission even though permission has already been granted). It tells you to use Gallery to delete the pictures but when I do, they still show up in Photos! Big thumbs down because of yet another simple, widely reported bug that Google has done nothing to fix.

They seem to have removed the style overlays and transitions(8mm, documentary, punk, etc). I loved using them, they really added to the fun of making simple videos from photos and video. Add these back, please, they really add value to making videos. Stark transitions to the next video or photo is just terrible. At the very least make them fade in and out! As a photo viewer and simple editor it works perfectly.

The only reason I stayed with google photos after 5 years or so was because of the unlimited storage. Now that the policy has changed, its very dissapointing. I now have to find another way to save my photos, which is a big shame considering i really liked the format here. And i also really like the fact it backs everything up automatically. I am not going to buy for more storage a month, thats ridiculous.

Very good app for safe keeping your pictures and getting space back on your phone. Has decent photo editing capabilities. One VERY bad item is that when it offers a suggestion to make a purchase of a picture, book, etc it is possible for the purchase to take place while it is in your pocket. I had it make a purchase of a canvas while I was riding my bike. By the time I completed my ride it was past the time to cancel the purchase. Otherwise I would give the app 5 stars.

Great for backing up & sharing photos easily with people, but editing + album management is not polished. I should be able to batch rotate multiple photos simultaneously to save me the manual effort. Editing albums with location & text is awful on phone app and desktop, along with having to drag and drop to reorder things. Poor UX for albums with lots of photos. But, aside from that, it's a solid app with the convenience of the Google ecosystem.

sneaky. you start using it, then it asks if you want to free up space on your phone. if you do so, your pics on the phone are removed.Also, the albums don't sync with my messaging app. if you are in a group text and want to send a pic, it is way harder to find it than it should be. quickpic was better but it isn't better any more. if I could find a better pic app for my android, I would leave google photos.

Can't switch off video autoplay; whoever thought this was a good idea? That person should be sacked. Yes, you can disable it in the grid view, but try scrolling through your photos in a quiet place and next thing it blares out at top volume. Woke my partner up the other night as I was trying to post stuff onto social media. Taking these basics of control away from users is a sure way to drive them away. I'm off, and downloading an alternative. Used to like it. No longer.

Generally a good app to edit and organize your photos. Would have given it five stars, if it wasn't for the occasional freeze/crash every now and then. Observed this behavior acrose at least three different phones (pixel 4, 5 and 8 pro). On the plus side it's completely ad-free and there's only a single version that includes all the features, although some of the more advanced stuff seems to be available only on the latest Google Pixel phones for a while (eg magic eraser).

Good layout and great options within the app. BUT, after spending a good time organizing my folders, a "free up space" option came up. "Save up to 20 gb, these pics are already backed up", I said sweet! So I used it, MISTAKE! Now all my organized folders are gone and, although pics are available in the photos folder, there's no way to move them back to the original folders. So all the practicality of having them divided by folders is gone!

As much as I'd love to to give 5 stars, I have to keep in mind that Google photos does not allow to manually adjust photos or edit as they do automatically in stylized photos, such as color pop. I enjoy editng photos and saving them all in one space, which Google photos has allowed me to do one of those only. Even though I am a subscription customer to larger storage, editing is limited. Other than that, I have been preaching the app so I can share my quality photos with everyone.

Updating Feb 2018 review: The app has continually improved for the last 3+ years. Google has done a great job accommodating popular requests. However, it's still frustrating I can't rename a photo file from within the app! But Google (nearly) solved my primary complaint; tools to annotate directly on individual photos; though I confess that I rely on the Amazon photo editor INSTEAD OF the editor within GPhotos - specifically for the text-box feature to type text - when scribbling won't fit!

This app is fantastic. I left a very negative review a few years ago, but all of the problems I had with it have been fixed - and then some. It backs up my photos, has a great search feature, enables me to caption photos, suggests one-click edits like lighting correction, and has a lot of easy ways to sort and view photos. This is easily an essential app for me.

I love being surprised by collages and animations. Google Photos requires almost no effort and provides so much more than I'd ever ask from a photo gallery. The only thing I'd like to see improved is editing options so it could really be an all-in-one app. There's a bit, but it's quite limited. Otherwise, I love it! Recommend to all for storing and managing photos.

The only good thing I got from this was accessing pictures from several years ago, other than that, it isnt good, when I delete a video from my phone after being backed up (I made sure it was using original size), it deletes the video from the app, I lost a video I made and I will never be able to access it ever again, had to install an app that is like the samsung trash can so I dont lose another thing again.

I really enjoy using this photos app. However, I find it strange that some useful function that isn't baked into the experience. For example, a option to hide certain photos from the public view. Achieve isn't a sufficient place to put particular photos u don't ppl to see. Something behind a security wall should be put into place to access certain photos and videos.

UGH! The only reason I used this app was the sharing option. But for some reason, in the last few months, it won't let me see albums shared with me at all. It's full of bugs, searching is a nightmare, adding already uploaded photos to albums takes forever and I have to add a few at a time to make sure it doesn't miss any of my photos or videos. Super time consuming, frustrating and just an awful customer experience. Honestly, guys, you're freaking Google for crying out loud. Make an effort!!

Hi, I'm filling out this review to hopefully be of some help to y'all. I love the concept of the Google Photos App, however there are some 'Major' issues that just need a little tweaking so it's alot easier to use. I have the app because it came on my phone, I started using it and decided to take advantage of the 'Share Album' option with my relative who I sent a link to which shows only the new pictures that were just added, not the entire body of the album. I also allowed them to be able to add photos, comment & ect on the options list, but with just the link I sent she couldn't do it so in turn she downloaded the Google Photos App. And although I knew it took me awhile to get the hang of how to use it, I was quite dismayed wen she told me "Ok, I have got it DL, as soon as I figure out how to use it I will start adding photos too". The trouble is with the way you have formatted the options menu, there are No Clear, easy to understand options except for the Trash & Empty Trash options. It's really hard to know if you have actually Backed up successfully the photos chosen because the main screen doesn't just show those, it shows all of them together. Also, for a 'Lay-person I have no clue what the differences in the options are, wat the sizes mean to me if I decide to print a pic. Another confusing thing is the 'Archive' option. I don't know why it is that when I Archive a photo it seems to disappear from my album. Then I'm trying to figure out if the photo I just Archived can still be seen in my 'Shared Album' or not. I don't think it can be viewed by the person who I am sharing the album with. Well, I sure hope this helps all you fine people at Google. I do really like the app, but its just sorta confounding to Beginners like me,Thank you.

Love 3 things: 1. It automatically organizes photos into albums, a task I find tedious otherwise. 2. It suggested I free up nearly 5 GB by deleting from the phone the backed up photos. 3. It reminds me from time to time that I have a timeline, which sometimes inspires me to share pics again, or is just nice to be reminded of that great vacation. When Google gets it right it is REALLY WONDERFUL!

Very useful. Nice editing features and the sync across devices is good but the search functionality could be vastly improved. It's difficult to find anything when all photos titles are numbers and you have photos going back to 2007 and earlier. I do like the way it groups photos into genres. I would very much like the option to download/save photos via the slideshows. Once they're gone, they're in the ether and almost impossible to find again.

It's good to keep track of your photos and videos. However there's 3 flaws i can think of right now: 1. The app keeps crashing when trying to edit photos. Even after clearing the storage it didn't fix it. 2. Sometimes when you are trying to move some pictures from folder to folder, it says there was an error moving this picture or video so you have to use file manager instead. 3. When moving photos and videos to a new folder (mainly large amounts), the photos are in random order.

I love this app because I can keep all my photos and videos in one spot, and make seperate folders. There's also seperate folders, the app separates people by their face using racial recognition. You can archive or delete photos, it's really nice to be able to use the photo editor on the app as well. There are many things you can do with them. Up until recently, Photos has been my go-to backup app for all my photos and videos. I've done all the "solutions" posted in the forums, to no avail! Please fix this problem ASAP. Thanks.

The various editing possibilities and story/scrapbook options are very cool. And even short films made from pictures taken in quick succession are suggested to the user. You can save the edit or say no and delete it. They help remind you to backup photos and upload them to Google and you save the space on your device. Smart and the logistics have been pretty well thought through. I'm new at the photography hobby so this is perfect for me.

I love knowing every time I'm in a trusted wifi area, my photos are being preserved. Even being in the computer industry, I have lost photos. Since I started using this app (I have not lost any), I have upgraded phones and not lost anything. Plus, with the newer generation phones, other than optical zoom, they rival my camera for quality. So the photos are worthy of preserving. Almost 3 years later, and it is even more amazing than it started out.

Absolutely love Google Photos. You can customise so much in the app, & I'm always finding new things to do. You can use the magic eraser to remove something in the photo you don't like (like the mother-in-law! Lol), which is a great feature. You can create movies from photos & videos or just a lovely collage. You can also order photo books too, either in paperback or hardback. This review & features available are based on my Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra. Features may be different on other phones.

Good app! I just have to suggestions: 1. PLEASE, make it so that you can put things in the trash from an album, it is extremely annoying to have to find a photo in an album that you want to discrad, look at the date, search for that date and then trash it. 2. It would be amazing if there was a view where you could see only photos that were not in albums, that way it is easier to organize. Please take these into consideration especially the first one.

Could still do with work. Truly awful idea that you are not pre-warned about only being able to add 500 photos to an album at a time. Just spent (wasted) my time going through selecting a load of photos to add to an album and when I press add it tells me that there is a limit and DESLECTS all the photos I just selected. Where is the logic in that? At the very least, let me go back and amend my selection to remove some photos from my current selection; or warn the user beforehand that the limit is 500 photos at a time; or remove the limit - take your pick! Could also really do with being able to preview photos/videos whilst adding them to an album. It can be hard to tell what a photo/video was and if it is relevant to the album or not. Currently, you would have to add your current selection up to that point or leave the current selection, go back to photos and check photo/video to see if it is relevant, then go back to adding photos to album again.

I really want to like the service, but I've using it for a few years now and the problems seem to only get worse. First, the app is very slow when creating albums from multiple pictures, even on a high end phone and when there aren't that many pictures. And when I try to share the album around 70% of the time I get an error and it asks me to try again later. Also, the app constantly stops syncing my pictures, and I have to clear the data and start everything again, which takes many hours. And I want to be able to choose my video quality, because right now it's either a hugely overcompressed file that is barely usable, or the original file which takes tons of space and is not very optimized. So I either waste time pre-processing the videos before uploading, or have to constantly throw money so that I can store my huge files. You own Youtube, I'm pretty sure you can have a better solution to handle videos. And there should be different options for compressed/original for photos and videos, because photo quality is acceptable but video is not.
